lessons.title: Next Steps
lessons.description:
Prior to moving on to Phase II, test for the following benchmarks below. These bodyweight exercises are key in establishing the necessary prerequisites prior to moving on to our next Phase II training. This upcoming Phase will focus on skill development, conditioning, and a wide range of new kettlebell exercises.

Level I Benchmarks:

Modified Butterflies: 50 reps (done continuously)Glute Bridges*: 20 each position (rest up to 30s in between sets)Abdominal Roll Ups: 30 (done continuously)

*Glute Bridges Four Lower Body Positions:

Feet and knees apart (inline with hips)Feet and knees togetherFeet apart, knees togetherFeet together, knees apart
